fib: ______ is an overall financial and operating plan for a forthcoming calendar or fiscal year.
master budget
A master budget is an overall financial and operating plan for a forthcoming calendar or fiscal year.
______ is the last real check a corporation has on the feasibility of its selected strategy.
Planning a budget
Planning a budget is the last real check a corporation has on the feasibility of its selected strategy.
______ is the discount rate which when applied gives zero net present value.
Internal Rate of Return
The Internal Rate of Return is the discount rate which when applied gives zero net present value.
______ is the judicious utilisation of resources on viable opportunities, with a view to earning reasonable returns beneficial to the providers of funds.
Investment
Investment is the judicious utilisation of resources on viable opportunities, with a view to earning reasonable returns beneficial to the providers of funds.
______ are those organisational units in which outputs are measured in monetary terms but are not directly compared to input costs.
Revenue centres
Revenue Centre Revenue centres are those organisational units in which outputs are measured in monetary terms but are not directly compared to input costs.
______ is the whole system of controls that ensure incomes and expenditures are in line with the budgets and that wastage is reduced to the barest minimum.
Budgetary control
Budgetary control is the whole system of controls that ensure incomes and expenditures are in line with the budgets and that wastage is reduced to the barest minimum.
______ is a major weakness in most organisations including government agencies in the country.
Planning
Planning is a major weakness in most organisations including government agencies in the country.
______ is a plan to balance expenditure against income, to balance the financial books.
Budgeting
Budgeting is a plan to balance expenditure against income, to balance the financial books.
______ is a financial document used to protect future income and expenses.
budget
A budget is a financial document used to protect future income and expenses.
______ means the overall objective of an organisation.
Goal congruence
Goal Congruence Goal congruence means the overall objective of an organisation.
______ is the process by which corporate activities and performance results are monitored so that actual performance can be compared with desired performance.
Evaluation and control
Evaluation and control is the process by which corporate activities and performance results are monitored so that actual performance can be compared with desired performance.
______ are the most powerful control technique at the disposal of the cost and management accountant.
Budgetary control and standard costing
Budgetary control and standard costing are the most powerful control technique at the disposal of the cost and management accountant.
______ is a cycle of events which occur sequentially every year and which results in the approved budget.
budget process
The budget process is a cycle of events which occur sequentially every year and which results in the approved budget.
______ is a unit cost concept whereas budgeted cost is a total cost concept.
Standard cost
Standard cost is a unit cost concept whereas budgeted cost is a total cost concept.
